result.topic_en: Euler introduces the third case, threads of unequal elasticity, replacing the constant elasticity A by a function S of the arc length s, and begins deriving the equilibrium equations for this case.
result.transcription:
CORP. SIVE FLEXIBIL. SEV ELASTIC. 391
etiam vbi in statu suo naturali non situm rectum tenet, sed secundum curuam quamcunque datam sit formatum; quocirca adhuc duos casus sequentes adiungamus.

Casus Tertius pro filis inaequaliter elasticis.

XV. Talis inaequalitas scilicet locum habere potest, si vel ipsum filum non vbique sit aeque crassum etiamsi ex eadem constet materia, vel si adeo ex diuersis materiis fuerit compositum, hoc igitur casu elasticitas in singulis punctis, non simpliciter formulae $\frac{d\Phi}{ds}$ erit proportionalis, sed praeterea a functione quadam pendebit, ad punctum quoduis M pertinente, vnde manifestum est hanc functionem per ipsam portionem fili $AM = s$, determinari debere; sit igitur S ista functio elasticitatem absolutam definiens, atque loco constantis illius A, casu praecedente hic scribi oportebit S, sicque tota solutio sequenti modo se habebit: Ante omnia debet esse $Vv = \frac{S\,d\Phi}{ds}$, cui insuper vt ante adiungi conuenit has tres:
I°. $dT + V\,d\Phi = p\,ds$; II°. $dV - T\,d\Phi = q\,ds$; III°. $dVv = V\,ds$,
ex vltima aequatione statim concluditur:
$$V = \frac{S\,dd\Phi + dS\,d\Phi}{ds^2},$$
posito elemento $ds$ constante, hincque vicissim:
$$v = \frac{S\,d\Phi\,ds}{S\,dd\Phi + dS\,.\,d\Phi},$$
qui valores in aequatione I$^a$. substituti dant:

$dT$

items.quote: quocirca adhuc duos casus sequentes adiungamus.
items.english: Therefore let us add the following two further cases.

items.quote: Casus Tertius pro filis inaequaliter elasticis.
items.english: Third case: for threads of unequal elasticity.

items.quote: vnde manifestum est hanc functionem per ipsam portionem fili $AM = s$, determinari debere
items.english: whence it is clear that this function must be determined by the portion of the thread AM = s itself.

items.quote:
ex vltima aequatione statim concluditur:
$$V = \frac{S\,dd\Phi + dS\,d\Phi}{ds^2},$$
posito elemento $ds$ constante
items.english: From the last equation it immediately follows that V = (S ddΦ + dS dΦ)/ds², taking the element ds as constant.
